title: Fill a steam-table well with gastronorm pans, no opening left
instruction: Fill the steam-table well with pans from the counter so that no opening is left: the pans must cover the whole well between them, each pan down flat inside the well. Leave any pan you do not need on the counter.
context: Hot-food steam tables and bain-maries take gastronorm pans (EN 631-1 sizes: 1/1, 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 and smaller fractions of a 530 x 325 mm well). Kitchen and serving-line procedures require every well to be filled completely with pans, adaptor bars or a lid: an open gap vents the steam and the food in the other pans can drop below the 57 C (135 F) hot-holding minimum of the FDA Food Code. Choosing pans is a fraction-and-shape problem: here only 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/4 fills the well, while 1/2 + 1/3 leaves a 1/6 opening. Unlike TK-3HLG9T (pick weights that sum to a target mass) or TK-BTYFXV (shelve books in a row with no gaps), the pans must sum to one well and be laid out in its one 2-D tiling; ManiSkill3 AssemblingKits fits one shape into one slot. Done by: cooks and food preparation workers (O*NET 35-2012.00, 35-2021.00, 35-3023.00).
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left), everything square to the table. Well: a fixed grey stainless frame (walls 0.6 cm thick, 0.8 cm tall) round an 11 x 16.8 cm opening (x by y), table floor, centred at x 36, y 26. Pans on the counter, open stainless boxes modelled solid (x by y by height): the 1/2 pan 10 x 8 x 5.5 cm, 150 g, at x 20, y 42; the 1/3 pan 10 x 5.3 x 4 cm, 90 g, at x 20, y 8; two 1/4 pans 4.95 x 8 x 2.5 cm, 60 g, at x 16, y 18 and y 30.
scoring: From a top photo and a ruler, with the grippers open. The well has two exact fillings, mirror images of each other: the 1/2 pan centred in one half of the well (along y) and the two 1/4 pans side by side in the other half. A pan is seated in its slot when it is down flat on the well floor (bottom within 3 mm, tilt under 6 degrees), square to the well within 6 degrees, its centre within 6 mm of the slot centre, and still. For the filling that is further along: 0.5 for the 1/2 pan seated and 0.25 for each 1/4 slot with a 1/4 pan seated in it. The 1/3 pan fills no slot. Possible scores: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0. Success: score 1, held 1 s.
reset_notes: Stand the four pans back on the counter at their marks, open side up. The well does not move.
fidelity: Rigid boxes with one shared friction (1.2 static, 1.0 dynamic). Gastronorm sizes are scaled to 0.3 in plan so the pans fit the 94 mm gripper; depths are not to scale. Pans are solid boxes with no rim, taper or food, and sit on the well floor instead of hanging by their rims; there is no water or steam. The well is a low open frame on the table.
